# Darth Plagueis (novel, read in full): feats, scaling, quotes and story notes

<!-- read up to: Epilogue (L7481), END OF BOOK. Written 2026-10-19 (America/New_York). -->

- **Book:** *Star Wars: Darth Plagueis* by James Luceno (Del Rey, 2012). Prequel-era novel told mostly from Plagueis's and Sidious's points of view.
- **Continuity:** Legends. It runs from **67 BBY** (the death of Tenebrous) to **32 BBY** (just after *The Phantom Menace*). There are three parts: Part One «Enlistment» 67–65 BBY (Ch1–12), Part Two «Apprenticed to Power» 54–52 BBY (Ch13–21), and Part Three «Mastery» 34–32 BBY (Ch22–30), plus a Prologue (32 BBY, the moment after Plagueis's death) and an Epilogue (32 BBY, after TPM). It ties into *Cloak of Deception* (Eriadu, Havac), *Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter* (Monchar, Lorn Pavan), *Saboteur* (Dorvalla), *Labyrinth of Evil* (Sifo-Dyas), and *Dark Lord* (11-4D's new body).
- **Source file:** `[local path]` (7,489 lines, ~121k words). Accented letters are lost in this file (it prints «Padm?», «ter?s k?si», «mat?riel»). Quotes keep the file's spelling, typos included (e.g. «rejuvinating», «apprenhensions», «appretice»).
- **Method:** I read every line in order in 13 chunks, from the Prologue through the Epilogue, and kept a reading log as I went (Appendix B). `L####` is the line number in the source file. Text inside «…» is copied exactly from the file. Every «…» quote in this file, plus the 748-entry quote register (`work-plag-lab/quotes-plag.txt`), was checked by script for an exact substring match and for the cited line (±3 lines). Results are in §11.
- **Chapter heading lines:** Prologue L111; Ch1 L171 *The Underworld*; Ch2 L393 *The Inner Landscape*; Ch3 L475 *Woebegone*; Ch4 L815 *The Meaning of Death*; Ch5 L1015 *Homecoming*; Ch6 L1243 *The Hunters' Moon*; Ch7 L1579 *There Where They Used to Stand*; Ch8 L1665 *Victims of Their Own Device*; Ch9 L2117 *Untapped Reserves*; Ch10 L2423 *The Cycle of Violence*; Ch11 L2687 *Avatar of Mortality*; Ch12 L3113 *Seduced by the Dark Side of the Force*; Ch13 L3183 *Riders on the Storm*; Ch14 L3325 *The Shape of His Shadow*; Ch15 L3603 *Quantum Being*; Ch16 L3817 *Bold as Love*; Ch17 L4101 *Days of Wine and Impropriety*; Ch18 L4327 *Artful Dodging*; Ch19 L4441 *The Trials*; Ch20 L4651 *The Canted Circle*; Ch21 L4813 *Investiture*; Ch22 L4977 *Ordinary Beings*; Ch23 L5185 *Under the Midnight Sun*; Ch24 L5323 *Sith'ari*; Ch25 L5637 *The Discreet Charm of the Meritocracy*; Ch26 L5923 *Their Baser Nature*; Ch27 L6095 *Calibrations*; Ch28 L6377 *Chain of Command*; Ch29 L6789 *The Force Strikes Back*; Ch30 L7053 *Taking the Future from the Now*; Epilogue L7305. About the Author L7485.
- **Feat vs. statement:** **FEAT** means the narration shows it happening. **STATEMENT** means a character says or thinks it. Luceno writes in close third person, so a lot of the "narration" is a character's view; I mark those *(POV: name)*. Much of the hype here is Sidious's view of Plagueis or Plagueis's view of himself. That matters for the Plagueis vs Sidious question, because Sidious's own estimates of Plagueis swing between envy («almost omnipotent») and contempt («You useless old fool»).
- **Version tags (required on every feat and statement):**
  - **Plagueis:**
    - **P-67**: 67 BBY. He has just killed Tenebrous and taken the Rule-of-Two succession, but cannot yet manipulate midi-chlorians, and is wounded in Ch1–4.
    - **P-65**: 65–64 BBY, while recruiting and training Palpatine.
    - **P-54a**: ~54 BBY, before the Maladian attack.
    - **P-54b**: ~54 BBY, after the Maladians. He is maimed and wears a transpirator, but is «no less strong in the Force».
    - **P-41 (amp)**: the "galactonic" shift ~41 BBY, with Venamis's resurrection the same day, then self-rejuvenation and a raised midi-chlorian count.
    - **P-33/32**: Part Three, his prime («a full recovery»).
    - **P-32 (death)**: drunk, asleep and ambushed.
  - **Sidious/Palpatine:**
    - **S-65**: untrained, age 17–18 (Ch9–11).
    - **S-64**: neophyte (Ch12).
    - **S-54**: age 28, eleven years apprenticed (Ch13–21).
    - **S-41 (amp)**: co-participant in the shift.
    - **S-33/32**: TPM-era Sidious.
    - **S-32+ (boost)**: the moment of Plagueis's death, the Prologue's «intensification».
  - **Others:** **T-67** Tenebrous, **V-67** Venamis, **M-33/32** Maul (TPM-era), **D-54** / **D-33/32** Dooku, **QG-54** / **QG-32** Qui-Gon.
- **Headline:** This is **the book of Plagueis's mastery of midi-chlorians and his murder**.
  - Plagueis kills Tenebrous by treachery (Ch1) and outduels Venamis (Ch6).
  - He survives a Maladian ambush with a severed trachea and «all but atomized» a dozen killers (Ch20).
  - With Sidious he «willing the Force to shift» (Ch24). The same day he resurrects Venamis again and again, then rejuvenates himself, and later kills Veruna by telling his midi-chlorians «to return to their source» (Ch27).
  - He foresees the boy, the cyborg and Maul's end (Ch29–30). Then he is murdered in his sleep by an apprentice who calls himself «The Sith'ari».
  - **For scaling:**
    - The book never puts Plagueis and Sidious in a fair fight. The one "fight" is an ambush on a drunk, sleeping Plagueis who «stopped short of defending himself».
    - The book's own comparative lines are hedged: «Was he a level behind? Two levels behind?» (Sidious POV); «his equally powerful apprentice» (Sidious's own claim).
    - The narration states Plagueis's limits outright: he lacked an innate gift for sorcery, can be blinded by fixation, and is often outmaneuvered.

## 2. Chapter-by-chapter plot

**Prologue (L111), 32 BBY.** Moments after the murder, a tremor «Sprung from death» spreads out from Sidious, and he feels «the Force so strong within him that he feared he might disappear into it, never to return» L117. Plagueis lies face down in a room left «As if a whirlwind had swept through» L121. Sidious fears a trick: «Had Plagueis unlocked the key to immortality, and survived after all?» L133. He rolls the body over with the Force, from a distance, and confirms the death. «though he could save others from death-he had failed to save himself» L145. Last line of the scene: «Had the Force ever been so strong in anyone?» L163.

### Part One: Enlistment (67–65 BBY)
**Ch1 The Underworld (L171).** Bal'demnic. Tenebrous and Plagueis inspect a cortosis-rich cave. A mining probe disobeys and strikes lethane. Both Sith pour lightning into the shaft, but the cortosis blocks it («There's too much resistance here» L271). The explosion forces them to flee, with Plagueis needing «to call deeply on the Force merely to keep up» L293. Tenebrous throws up a Force shield to contain the fireball. Both hold up the falling ceiling, and then Plagueis brings it down on his Master, «so quickly and with so much momentum that Tenebrous was buried almost before he understood what had hit him» L321. Plagueis gloats («Go to your grave knowing that you are last of the old order» L359), breaks Tenebrous's neck, and watches his midi-chlorians fade. At this point he can perceive midi-chlorians but cannot manipulate them (L377 «though not yet the ability to manipulate them»).

**Ch2 The Inner Landscape (L393).** Plagueis is badly hurt. He numbs the pain, levitates slabs into a ramp (he cannot leap the oculus unaided), Force-blows his way into the ship, and takes both lightsabers. He runs at blur speed to the spaceport. He senses «something or some being of near-equal power» L443. He has a glimpse of Bal'demnic's future war, and chooses the freighter *Woebegone*.

**Ch3 Woebegone (L475).** He stows away in a freezer and survives on two voluntarily controlled hearts. The crew (Ellin Lah, Maa Kaap, Blir', Semasalli, Wandau, PePe Rossh, Doo Zuto, and the droid 11-4D) consider ransoming him. «I can't permit this, Captain» L803. «Their fates had been sealed from the instant Plagueis had glimpsed the ship on the landing field.» L807

**Ch4 The Meaning of Death (L815).** Told from 11-4D's POV, the massacre: Plagueis evades, deflects or returns every shot; absorbs blaster bolts with his bare hand and re-emits them as lightning; kicks Maa Kaap across the cabin; becomes immovable «as if the Muun had turned to stone» L841; and cuts down the rest. He tries to keep the dying alive and fails because the midi-chlorians won't cooperate. At Deep Space Demo (Boss Cabra) he is «Magister Damask» and has the ship slagged. He keeps 11-4D.

**Ch5 Homecoming (L1015).** Muunilinst: Larsh Hill, Tonith, Damask Holdings. He announces that «Rugess Nome is dead» L1117 and buys up the Bal'demnic rights. At the Aborah library-lab he states his goal: «The goal is to extend my life indefinitely. To conquer death.» L1205 The succession boost is real, but his midi-chlorian count «had not increased» L1221. The dark side now feels like «a hurricane» L1237.

**Ch6 The Hunters' Moon (L1243).** The Gathering on Sojourn, with Gardulla, the Yinchorri envoy Qayhuk («resistant to Force suggestion» L1333), Pax Teem, the Subtext Gossams and the steering committee. Plagueis senses an intruder, minimizes his presence, and meets **Darth Venamis**, Tenebrous's secret second apprentice. They duel. Venamis, trained in Plagueis's own style, sears his neck. Plagueis goes «marionette», disarms him, and Venamis yields. Plagueis feeds him poison: «But I will make certain you don't die.» L1575

**Ch7 There Where They Used to Stand (L1579).** Venamis is kept in bacta as an experimental subject. Plagueis rejects Tenebrous's Bith fatalism. Backstory: Hego was bred via Bith science; before age five he made a playmate jump out a window by suggestion («If you're in such a rush to get downstairs, then jump out the window.» L1637); he was traded to Rugess Nome. Tenebrous's creed: «A phantom menace.» L1655

**Ch8 Victims of Their Own Device (L1665).** Plagueis hunts down Venamis's candidates:
- the Shi'ido casino cheat on Lianna, who perceives his Force probe;
- the Iktotchi prophetess on Saleucami, who foretells the Empire («A galaxy brought under the yoke of a ruthless despot» L1873) and whom he kills with trickled lightning;
- Naat Lare in the Abraxin marshes. Plagueis summons Naat Lare from under the water and sets him on Jedi Master Ni-Cada and Lo Bukk while hiding himself from them. Ni-Cada kills Naat Lare.

**Ch9 Untapped Reserves (L2117).** Naboo politics (Veruna, Tapalo). Plagueis wants «a partner rather than an underling» L2137. He meets the young Palpatine, who tells him he wants «Everything» L523. Even «submerged... deeply in the Force», Plagueis «was unable to glean very much» L2365.

**Ch10 The Cycle of Violence (L2423).** Palpatine has killed two pedestrians while racing, hates his father, and has «rejected the name I was given» L2503. «The psychic walls the youth had raised were impenetrable» L2509. Malastare: the Subtext Gossams are executed. Cosinga Palpatine warns Damask off his son.

**Ch11 Avatar of Mortality (L2687).** On Chandrila, Palpatine's fury bends the plants and buffets Plagueis. «I want to rule.» L2771 On the *Jafan III*, Cosinga tries to send him away. Palpatine, untrained, hurls him into a bulkhead that buckles, and kills his father, mother, siblings and guards. Plagueis, in a trance over Venamis, feels it: «A rite performed; a confirmation conferred.» L2943 «I became a storm, Magister... I was death itself!» L3051 Plagueis warns him: «What you sense is a fraction of what I can bring to bear.» L3089 He names him Sidious.

**Ch12 Seduced by the Dark Side of the Force (L3113).** Training in the snows of Mygeeto. «until I've guided you to parity» L3145. Illusion trick: «he had never been there to begin with» L3153. Sidious is thrown back by «an irresistible force» L3157 and covered in lightsaber burns. «Not a standard day sooner than a decade.» L3179

### Part Two: Apprenticed to Power (54–52 BBY)
**Ch13 Riders on the Storm (L3183).**
- Buoyant: a Force "summoning" hunt in which Sidious draws an animal's life into himself.
- Plagueis's lightning lecture: «true Sith lightning... has the power... to physically transform the victim» L3217.
- Hypori: Plagueis orbits Sidious inside rings of 200 droids, «warded off every volley» L3229.
- Kursid: a massacre of primitive warriors, and the heart-eating.
- «a cunning politician is capable of wreaking more havoc than two Sith Lords» L3315.

**Ch14 The Shape of His Shadow (L3325).** Ambassador Palpatine, age 28, at a Malastare gala. Vidar Kim's family dies in a crash, and Palpatine senses it in the Force before the news comes. «the Muun remained the powerful one, and Palpatine the covetous one» L3401.

**Ch15 Quantum Being (L3603).** Plagueis breaks the Yinchorri «Force bubble» L3611. His experiments cover volition, telepathy, healing, regeneration and life extension. The Sith goal is «toppling the Force itself» L3619. Palpatine takes the infant **Maul** on Dathomir and mind-wipes the Nightsister mother. On Sojourn they plan the chancellorship («You will see to that, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.» L3767). Plagueis tells the story of choking Kerred Santhe, demonstrates on Sidious, and names Vidar Kim as the next target.

**Ch16 Bold as Love (L3817).** Plagueis: «we are not afraid to feel» L3825. Kamino (Ko Sai, Lac Nor, Ni Timor): cloning Yinchorri, then humans. A Maladian kills Vidar Kim; the real message is aimed at the Senate. Pestage joins.

**Ch17 Days of Wine and Impropriety (L4101).** Palpatine hides «in plain sight». At Count Vemec's castle on Serenno, Plagueis meets Dooku («one of the Order's finest lightsaber masters» L4185), Sifo-Dyas and Qui-Gon, and «drew the cloak of the profane over himself» L4205. He plants «Grown, then.» L4313 The dark side chokes off his voice before he can say «Kamino» L3971.

**Ch18 Artful Dodging (L4327).** In the Senate Plaza Sidious reflects that he and Plagueis are «more than equal to the most powerful of the Jedi Order» but «no match for their combined strength» L4339. Plagueis was hidden even from Sidious (L4387 «power to completely conceal himself, even from a fellow Sith»). Naboo abstains in the vote, and chaos follows.

**Ch19 The Trials (L4441).** Sidious studies Sith sorcery on his own. At the Shimmersilk he mind-tricks a lobbyist, reveals the hidden blasters, pre-nullifies poisons, and lets the Gran abduct him. Plagueis was using him as bait, and Sun Guards storm in. «Is there an end to these trials?» «When there is no further need of them.» L4647

**Ch20 The Canted Circle (L4651).** The Maladian ambush in the Fobosi. A disk severs Plagueis's trachea. «Tricked... Outmaneuvered by a group of inferior beings» L4673. With failing hearts he still kills with his hands, turns loose objects into a projectile storm, raises a Force shield, roars sonically, and conjures «a Force wave that all but atomized the bodies of six Maladians» L4765. His lightning attempt fails. Sidious and Pestage arrive and finish off the rest. Sidious then massacres the Gran embassy alone and roasts Pax Teem.

**Ch21 Investiture (L4813).** Aborah is a «transcendent vortex of dark energy» L4821. Force-induced pregnancies. The transpirator. «Soon I will be stronger than you can possibly imagine.» L4871 The Force «will strike back» L4895. Maul is to train on Orsis. «we are the end of the line» L4973.

### Part Three: Mastery (34–32 BBY)
**Ch22 Ordinary Beings (L4977).** The Yinchorr crisis in Valorum's Senate. The «galactonic» midi-chlorian breakthrough L5035. The 500 Republica party. Yoda is «Inscrutable as ever... But troubled» L5173.

**Ch23 Under the Midnight Sun (L5185).** Maul's hologram and the Hypori test («deprived him of his lightsaber» L5205). Plagueis is «a nuclear oval of mottled light» L5193. Sidious feels his powers «increased tenfold», but wonders «Was he a level behind? Two levels behind?» L5255. Gunray is to receive the pylat "from Darth Sidious".

**Ch24 Sith'ari (L5323).** Veruna's N-1s and his betrayal. Flashback: the etheric war that tips the Force; Venamis resurrected again and again; self-rejuvenation; a failed attempt at creating life; a raised midi-chlorian count. Maul is made «Darth» and turns prideful. Sidious reveals himself to Gunray.

**Ch25 The Discreet Charm of the Meritocracy (L5637).** Jabba visits Sojourn and brings word of Komari Vosa. Dooku tells Palpatine he will leave the Order and explains the Chosen One prophecy. Palpatine recruits Padmé, then 13, through Ruwee and Jobal.

**Ch26 Their Baser Nature (L5923).** Maul is restless after Dorvalla and Havac's betrayal. At Veruna's fete with Black Sun, Gardulla and the Bando Gora, Veruna threatens Palpatine. Plagueis reflects that Sidious's «gift for subterfuge... surpassed... Bane» L6027. Sojourn is nuked. Plagueis escapes in the cloaked Infiltrator, and Jabba picks him up.

**Ch27 Calibrations (L6095).** Back at Kaldani Spires. Plagueis: «by killing one, we can frighten many» L6123. Maul receives the *Scimitar* and the Black Sun mission. Sidious can't see the future and wonders whether he «failed to divine Veruna's attack» L6197. Plagueis infiltrates Veruna's castle (Force leap, wall-climb, telekinesis, muting) and kills him by midi-chlorian command: «I am Darth Plagueis, Veruna. Your shepherd.» L6367

**Ch28 Chain of Command (L6377).** Maul's debrief: Sinya decapitated, Mighella halved, Garyn drowned after cutting Maul's hand. Sidious exiles him to Orsis. The war plan (Geonosis, a long war, a «grown army»). The Monchar affair. At the Perlemian Orbital Facility, Damask recruits Sifo-Dyas for the Kamino order («a human army a million strong» L6667). Pavan hands over the holocron, and Maul kills him. The blockade begins.

**Ch29 The Force Strikes Back (L6789).** Valorum sends Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan. Plagueis: «Qui-Gon will evade detection by the droids» L6841. Plagueis watches Sidious and Maul unseen, foresees trouble, and sees «that this was the last time he and his apprentice might see each other in the flesh» L6875. Dooku tells Palpatine about Anakin. Palpatine: «And I sensed nothing about him.» L6995 Plagueis misses Anakin at 500 Republica. «Are we undone?» L7049

**Ch30 Taking the Future from the Now (L7053).** Palpatine is nominated. Plagueis's vision of «a black-helmeted cyborg rising from a table» L7095. He knows «the battle was lost and that the boy would not die» L7111. Night at the opera, then the penthouse. Plagueis falls asleep after the Sullustan wine. Sidious attacks with lightning, delivers his indictment, survives the Force storm, and chokes him to death. «The Sith'ari.» L7269

**Epilogue (L7305).** Palpatine is elected. Damask's death goes barely noticed. Maul has fallen to «a lesser one» L7317. Dooku leaves the Order and wants «to learn the secrets of the dark side» L7417. Obi-Wan and Anakin visit: «we will continue to follow your career with great interest» L7479.

## 3. Feats by character (chapter order, version-tagged)

Format: **[Version] Ch# — feat.** exact quote in guillemets, then L#### → result → what it implies for scaling. FEAT = shown on the page. (POV) = filtered through a character's perception.

### 3.1 Darth Plagueis

**P-67 (67 BBY; fresh Rule-of-Two succession; wounded from Ch1 through Ch4)**
1. **[P-67] Ch1 — lightning into a cortosis borehole (shared with Tenebrous).** «Instantly tangles of blue electrical energy discharged from their fingertips, raining into the borehole.» L267 → it fails because of the ore («There's too much resistance here» L271) → cortosis beats both Sith's lightning, a material limit and not a power ranking.
2. **[P-67] Ch1 — speed vs Tenebrous.** «Plagueis had to call deeply on the Force merely to keep up» L293 → in a flat-out run, Tenebrous (T-67) > Plagueis (P-67).
3. **[P-67] Ch1 — catches the falling ceiling, then drops it on his Master.** «scrambling to his feet with arms lifted in an attempt to hold the rocks in midair» L309; «brought them down so quickly and with so much momentum that Tenebrous was buried almost before he understood what had hit him» L321 → kills a Sith Master by surprise → a kill by treachery, with **no evidence that Plagueis could beat Tenebrous in a fair fight**. Tenebrous himself credits «your skillful use of surprise and misdirection» L361.
4. **[P-67] Ch1 — midi-chlorian perception only.** «had honed an ability to perceive the actions of midi-chlorians, though not yet the ability to manipulate them» L377 → baseline for the later amps.
5. **[P-67] Ch2 — self-triage and telekinesis while wounded.** «he numbed himself to the pain and tasked his body to limit the damage» L399; «began to levitate slabs from the ship» L409; «assailing the transparisteel canopy with a series of Force blows» L411. **Limit:** «Not even his power in the Force was enough to carry him from the floor and up through the grotto's unblinking eye.» L405
6. **[P-67] Ch2 — blur speed over two nights.** «until to any being watching he would have appeared a dazzling blur» L427; body-temperature and breath control L429 («Lowering his body temperature»).
7. **[P-67] Ch2 — precognition and sensing.** «The knotted tendrils of time loosened and he had a glimpse into Bal'demnic's future.» L461; senses «near-equal power» L443 (Venamis or Palpatine; never resolved).
8. **[P-67] Ch3 — cardiac control in a freezer.** «Two of them are under voluntary control» L617 → Muun biology plus Force.
9. **[P-67] Ch4 — Woebegone massacre, wounded and fatigued (11-4D POV).** «evaded, deflected, or returned every shot that targeted him» L831; saber throw L833 («hurled the lightsaber in a spinning arc»); **bolt absorption:** «the Muun merely stretched out his right hand and absorbed the bolts» L835 and returned them «as a tangle of blue electricity» L835; a kick drives Maa Kaap «clear across the cabin» L839; grabbed by two beings, «as if the Muun had turned to stone» L841; ends Wandau «with a click of his thumb and middle finger» L853. → seven non-Force crew killed, with his own sloppiness admitted: «sloppiness on his part, owing to fatigue and blood loss» L881. **Bolt absorption into lightning is a rare skill and a real top-tier marker.**
10. **[P-67] Ch4 — failed healing.** «Maa Kaap snapped back to panic-stricken consciousness» L845, but «the results had been temporary» L879 → healing is easy («no more difficult than levitating slabs of stone» L879), but sustaining life needs midi-chlorian control he does not have yet.
11. **[P-67] Ch4 — direct midi-chlorian perception.** «perceive the midi-chlorians that individualized Forceful beings» L883.
12. **[P-67] Ch5 — the succession boost is real, but the count is flat.** «Despite the recent amplification of his powers he sensed that his midi-chlorian count had not increased» L1221; the dark side felt «as a hurricane» L1237 → a **separate version**: the Rule-of-Two amp raises his felt power, not his midi-chlorian count.
13. **[P-67] Ch6 — presence suppression.** «Damask minimized his presence in the Force, surrendering his eminence» L1493.
14. **[P-67] Ch6 — DUEL vs Darth Venamis (V-67).** Context: «To Plagueis, lightsaber duels were tedious affairs» but Tenebrous «had pronounced Plagueis a master of the art» L1547. He Force-blows Venamis's branch away L1547 («severed it with a Force blow»). Venamis «could not only anticipate but counter Plagueis's every move» L1547 and lands a hit: «searing the side of Plagueis's neck» L1549. Plagueis turns it around: «he took himself out of his body and began working his material self like a marionette» L1553, then «came back into himself with such fury that his lightsaber became a blinding rod» L1555, and wins the race for Venamis's saber («Plagueis was a split second quicker» L1557). Venamis yields L1557. → **A mid-diff win over a specialist trained to counter him, with damage taken.** The "marionette" technique is a unique dueling tool. Plagueis is a **master-rated** duelist who dislikes dueling.
15. **[P-67] Ch8 — Force-reading the Shi'ido.** He senses «an extraordinary surge of psychic energy» L1747; **limit:** «the Kubaz had perceived the intrusion» L1749.
16. **[P-67] Ch8 — lightning-kills a Force-sensitive seer.** «Plagueis began to trickle lightning into her» L1915; mind trick in a «deep monotone» L1919.
17. **[P-67] Ch8 — hides from a Jedi Master at close range.** «Plagueis anchored himself in the material realm» L2017 while the Padawan and Ni-Cada pass. He summons Naat Lare telepathically: «opened himself fully to the Force and summoned the Nautolan» L2063.

**P-65 (65–64 BBY)**
18. **[P-65] Ch9 — can't read Palpatine.** «Plagueis submerged himself deeply in the Force to study Palpatine, but he was unable to glean very much.» L2365 → an untrained S-65 can block P-65's probe. This is a defensive "mind wall" statement for Sidious, not a power ranking.
19. **[P-65] Ch11 — a remote dark-side surge felt mid-experiment.** «focused on communicating his will directly to the Force's intermediaries» L2941 (working on Venamis's midi-chlorians already).
20. **[P-65] Ch12 — weather aura, illusion, and an irresistible push.** Snow «melting before they reached him» L3117. «he had never been there to begin with» L3153 is a **Force illusion that fools a talented apprentice**. «only to meet an irresistible force and be hurled backward» L3157. «Without extending a hand, Plagueis tugged him to his feet.» L3161

**P-54a (~54 BBY, pre-Maladian)**
21. **[P-54a] Ch13 — lightning storm.** «loosed a storm of Force lightning that crackled over the landscape, igniting fires in the grass» L3215.
22. **[P-54a] Ch13 — Hypori droid rings.** «Orbiting Sidious, the Muun's blade warded off every volley, returning the bolts to their sources» L3229, and he dodges by centimeters L3229 → a 200-droid gauntlet shared with S-54. It is fodder, but it shows clean defensive saber work.
23. **[P-54a] Ch13 — Kursid.** «flying among them like wraiths» L3293; he rips out a heart L3293.
24. **[P-54a] Ch15 — midi-chlorian persuasion, a first real manipulation.** He breaks the Yinchorri «Force bubble» L3611; «Already he could command them to promote healing» L3625.
25. **[P-54a] Ch15 — Force choke on Sidious (S-54), by surprise.** «Plagueis brought the thumb and forefinger of his left hand close together, and Sidious, taken by surprise, felt his throat close.» L3801 → P-54a can choke S-54 at will when S-54 is off guard. Sidious later lists it as a grievance: «once choked him in a demonstration of his superiority» L7229.
26. **[P-54a] Ch15 (backstory) — choke-kill of Kerred Santhe.** «no drug or resuscitation technique was equal to the task of keeping him alive» L3805.
27. **[P-54a] Ch17 — conceals himself from Dooku, Sifo-Dyas, Qui-Gon and Jocasta Nu at conversation range.** «drew the cloak of the profane over himself» L4205 → his stealth beats four Jedi, including two Masters.
28. **[P-54a] Ch17 — the dark side acts on him.** «strangling his voice box, as if refusing to let the word escape» L4321 → the Force has agency over Plagueis's plans. This is a narrative limit.
29. **[P-54a] Ch18 — hidden from Sidious himself.** «That he hadn't sensed his Master spoke to Plagueis's power to completely conceal himself, even from a fellow Sith.» L4387 → stealth ≥ S-54's senses.
30. **[P-54a] Ch20 — failure of foresight.** «instead of acting on impulse, he restrained himself» L4665; «Tricked... Outmaneuvered by a group of inferior beings» L4673; «had neglected to consider that the Gran might also have a plan» L4739 → **a real weakness: his danger sense fires, and he overrides it out of fear of exposure.**

**P-54b (~54 BBY, the Maladian fight onward: trachea severed, hearts failing; ★ key feat)**
31. **[P-54b] Ch20 — fights on after a mortal wound.** «a disk had made off with a considerable hunk of his jawbone and neck, and in its cruel passing had severed his trachea» L4671; «He cupped the Force against the injury» L4671; chemical cardioversions L4671; «catapulted himself to his feet» L4759.
32. **[P-54b] Ch20 — the Maladian massacre.** «snapping necks and putting his fists through armored torsos» L4761; «he clapped his hands together, turning every loose object in the vicinity into a deadly projectile» L4761; a Force shield vs massed fire L4763 («the Force shield he raised»); a sonic roar «shattering the eardrums of those within ten meters» L4763; **«He stopped once to conjure a Force wave that all but atomized the bodies of six Maladians. He spun through a turn, dragging the wave halfway around the room to kill half a dozen more.»** L4765; «rattled the floor» L4767, with «life enough to conjure one final counteroffensive» L4767. **Limit:** «His second subsidiary heart failed» when he tried lightning L4763. → The Maladians are a Jedi-killing cult («Members of the cult had killed and wounded Jedi» L4761). Investigators later count «three times that number» of Maladian dead L4817 (≈36 across Plagueis, Sidious and Pestage). **This is the book's strongest raw-power showing for Plagueis: the atomizing Force wave, delivered while dying.**
33. **[P-54b] Ch21 — power intact after the injury.** «the Muun was no less strong in the Force» L4865 (POV: Sidious); «Soon I will be stronger than you can possibly imagine.» L4871
34. **[P-54b] Ch21 — Force-induced pregnancies.** «the pregnancies were not achieved by normal means of conception, but rather through the Force» L4891; «His success rate has improved.» L4853 → partial creation-of-life ability (in animals).

**P-41 (amp; the flashback in Ch24, ~41 BBY, "almost a decade" before 33 BBY; ★★ amp event)**
35. **[P-41 + S-41] Ch24 — the galactonic shift (shared).** «they had succeeded in willing the Force to shift and tip irrevocably to the dark side» L5429; «Risen out of themselves, discorporate and as a single entity, they had brought the power of their will to bear, asserting their sovereignty over the Force.» L5431; «the Force had yielded, as if some deity had been tipped from its throne» L5431. Also in Ch22: «Both of them suspected that the Jedi had sensed it as well» L5035 → a cosmological feat, but **months of joint meditation**, so it isn't combat-applicable. It also explains the later Jedi clouding in the Prequels. **Neither can claim it alone.**
36. **[P-41] Ch24 — RESURRECTION of Venamis.** «by manipulating the Bith's midi-chlorians, which should have been inert and unresponsive, Plagueis had resurrected him» L5435; «again and again allowing Venamis to die and be returned to life» L5435. Sidious was «stunned... into silence» (same line) → **the canonical "save others from death" feat, on a comatose subject.**
37. **[P-41] Ch24 — self-rejuvenation.** «his entire body was rejuvinating itself» L5437 [sic]; «eventually he would cease to age altogether» L5437.
38. **[P-41] Ch24 — failed Force-creation of a being.** «The Force grew silent, as if in flight from him» L5443 → a limit.
39. **[P-41] Ch24 — the count rises.** «The evidence was in his own increased midi-chlorian count» L5445 → **P-41 and after is a separate, higher version than P-67 and P-54.**
40. **[P-41→] Ch24 — limits on sorcery.** «But Plagueis had never succeeded in duplicating any of those phenomena» L5425 (weather, flight, invisibility, teleportation); «Tenebrous had told him that he lacked the talent for Sith sorcery» L5427; he believes «no powers beyond his reach» L5427 (self-assessment).

**P-33/32 (Part Three, his prime)**
41. **[P-33] Ch23 — Force-sight of his aura (POV: narration/Sidious).** «Seen through the Force, he was a nuclear oval of mottled light, a rotating orb of terrifying energy.» L5193; «a vessel sufficiently strong to contain the full power of the dark side» L5193; «master the equally powerful energies of order and disorder, creation and entropy, life and death» L5193.
42. **[P-33] Ch25 — Force lie-detection on a Force-immune Hutt.** «Jabba wasn't lying.» L5701
43. **[P-32] Ch26 — survives a nuclear strike (tech, not Force).** «leveling everything within a twenty-kilometer radius» L6061 → the cloaked Infiltrator plus Jabba's warning. **No Force credit.**
44. **[P-32] Ch27 — the castle infiltration.** «leapt to the top without breaking stride» L6277 (a 10 m wall); «fastened to it like an insect» L6295; «pushing inward on the pane until it broke free» L6295; mutes Veruna («attempted to scream until his voice went mute» L6313).
45. **[P-32] Ch27 — ★ midi-chlorian KILL.** «I have instructed the limited number you possess to return to their source. In plain Basic, Veruna, I am killing you.» L6355 → a death by midi-chlorian command on a non-Force-user with a «limited number». **Speed:** it takes a conversation's length. **Whether it would work on a Jedi Master mid-fight is not shown.** Self-claim: «every death I oversee nourishes and empowers me» L6359.
46. **[P-32] Ch27 / Ch29 / Ch30 — precognition.** He senses he «had already seen and traveled this path» L6369; «the gates that obscured the future parted» L6869; he foresees «the last time he and his apprentice might see each other in the flesh» L6875; «a black-helmeted cyborg rising from a table» L7095; «he knew that the battle was lost and that the boy would not die» L7111 → **far better foresight than S-32's** (see §3.2 #24). Even so, he does not foresee his own murder: the Ch27 déjà vu is ambiguous.
47. **[P-32] Ch29 — hides from Sidious and Maul while watching them.** «his presence in the Force minimized» L6853.
48. **[P-32] Ch29 — compulsion.** «compelling her to answer him» L7027.

**P-32 (death; drunk, asleep, ambushed; ★★ the "fight")**
49. **[P-32 death] Ch30 — asleep for the first time in twenty years.** «In twenty years of never having had to contend with Plagueis in a state of sleep» L7207.
50. **[P-32 death] Ch30 — takes lightning without defending.** «a web of blue lightning ground itself on the Muun's breathing device. Plagueis's eyes snapped open, the Force gathering in him like a storm, but he stopped short of defending himself» L7219; «actually courting death to put it in its place» L7219 (POV: Sidious speculating). → He survives two lightning barrages (the second «drawing more deeply on the dark side than he ever had» L7221), but **he is suffocating**, because the lightning was aimed at the transpirator. **He did not "shrug it off".** He chose not to defend (or was too impaired to), and the damage came through the breathing device.
51. **[P-32 death] Ch30 — Force storm while suffocating.** «A Force storm gathered over the couch, spreading out in concentric rings, to wash over Sidious and hurl objects to all corners. In the center of it, Plagueis's form became anamorphic» L7243 → reflexive power even while dying. It **washed over Sidious without stopping him.**
52. **[P-32 death] Ch30 — midi-chlorian self-rescue fails.** «your own midi-chlorians can't accomplish what you're asking of them» L7255 (Sidious's claim) → **his self-preservation ability fails under suffocation plus choke.** «One who could oversee the lives and deaths of all beings, except himself.» L7261
53. **Result:** «Death rattled his lungs and he died.» L7285

### 3.2 Darth Sidious / Palpatine

**S-65 (untrained, about 17–18)**
1. **[S-65] Ch10 — mental walls.** «The psychic walls the youth had raised were impenetrable, which made the young human something rare indeed.» L2509 (POV: Plagueis).
2. **[S-65] Ch11 — precognition as a teenager.** He foresaw Plagueis's visit: «Almost always.» L2701
3. **[S-65] Ch11 — fury affects nature and buffets Plagueis.** «Palpatine's fury buffeted Plagueis. Blossoms growing along the sides of the pathway folded in on themselves» L2725; «Was the Force so strong in him that it had concealed itself?» L2725 (POV: Plagueis).
4. **[S-65] Ch11 — the family massacre, untrained.** «hurled back against the bulkhead» L2913; «thwarted his effort without raising a finger» L2915; «the bulkhead against which he was slouched buckled inward» L2919; «tossed him clear across the cabin» L2937; «I killed them-even the guards.» L2979 → **untrained raw power that can buckle a starship bulkhead.** Plagueis feels it light-years away: «Stronger than any feeling he had experienced since the death of Darth Tenebrous» L2943.
5. **[S-65] Ch11 — potential (STATEMENT, Plagueis POV).** «he didn't realize just how powerful he was or how extraordinarily powerful he could become» L3055.

**S-64 (neophyte)**
6. **[S-64] Ch12 — falls for an illusion and is repelled by P-65.** «So easily tricked» L3155; «his body rashed with lightsaber burns» L3163 → S-64 < P-65 by a wide margin.

**S-54 (age 28, eleven years apprenticed)**
7. **[S-54] Ch13 — life-draining "summoning".** «Sidious drawing its power deep into himself» L3191.
8. **[S-54] Ch13 — self-built lightsaber; holds his ground in the droid rings.** «self-constructed of phrik alloy and aurodium, and powered by a synthetic crystal» L3225; «until the floor was piled high with smoking husks» L3239.
9. **[S-54] Ch14 — remote sensing of Kim's family's deaths.** «Palpatine dropped into the Force.» L3513
10. **[S-54] Ch15 — mind-wipes a Nightsister.** «You will forget this encounter.» L3723; and he «made himself discernible in the Force» at will L3639.
11. **[S-54] Ch17 — concealment from Jedi.** «visible in the Force, but not as a Sith» L4125 (Plagueis's instruction); «confident now that his true nature was beyond detection» L4173.
12. **[S-54] Ch18 — self-assessment (STATEMENT).** «he and Plagueis were more than equal to the most powerful of the Jedi Order, he understood that they were no match for their combined strength» L4339.
13. **[S-54] Ch19 — mind trick, telekinesis and anti-poison sorcery.** «You're not here to recruit me.» L4469; «used the Force to shift the apron» L4485; «His investigations into Sith sorcery had taught him how to nullify the effects of many common poisons and venoms» L4493 → **Sidious studies sorcery on his own, from texts «Plagueis dismissed as worthless»** L4449. This is a distinct skill tree.
14. **[S-54] Ch20 — remote danger sense.** «He opened himself fully to the Force, and was left staggered by an inrush of overwhelming malevolence.» L4731 → S-54 senses the attack Plagueis walked into.
15. **[S-54] Ch20 — the Gran embassy massacre, solo, with Plagueis's oversized saber.** «called on the Force to deliver him safely to a narrow ledge» L4787; «a blur to human senses» L4789; «levitate two guards into midair before running his blade through each of them» L4795; «ridding three guards of their heads and cutting a fourth in half at the waist» L4795; ceiling pull and fire control L4805 («brought down by Sidious's Force pull»); «he left not a single one of them alive» L4801 → a dozen-plus armed guards. Fodder, but a strong display of blur speed and multitasking.
16. **[S-54] Ch21 — vision of Aborah.** «a transcendent vortex of dark energy» L4821. Plagueis: «how powerful you have become, Lord Sidious» L4875.

**S-41 (amp, shared)**
17. **[S-41] Ch24 — co-author of the shift.** See Plagueis #35, «as a single entity» L5431. Afterward Plagueis «sensed in Sidious» increased power L5445 («the power he sensed in Sidious»).

**S-33/32 (TPM era)**
18. **[S-33] Ch23 — beats Maul in a test, disarming him.** «All things considered, he fought well, even after I deprived him of his lightsaber.» L5205 → **S-33 > M-33 with clear superiority** (it was a goading test; Maul «wanted to kill me»). This is newer, stronger evidence than the DSSB "nearly bested" line.
19. **[S-33] Ch23 — growth statement.** «Sidious knew that his own powers had increased tenfold over the decades» L5255 (POV: Sidious, self-assessment).
20. **[S-33] Ch24 — telekinetic threat across space.** «What if I told you that I could reach across space and time and strangle him where he perches?» L5593 → **a boast; never carried out.**
21. **[S-32] Ch27 — perception across space.** «Across the vastness of space, I can perceive the reeling of your feeble brain.» L6223 (rhetorical boast).
22. **[S-32] Ch26 — subterfuge rating (STATEMENT, Plagueis POV).** «Sidious had a gift for subterfuge that surpassed the talents of any of the Sith Lords who had preceded him, including Bane» L6027.
23. **[S-32] Ch27 — tracks the cloaked Scimitar through the dark side.** «Through the dark side, he continued to track the Scimitar» L6185.
24. **[S-32] Ch27 — limits on precognition.** «He directed his thoughts forward in time, yearning for a clear vision of the future, but none came.» L6193; «he had actually failed to divine Veruna's attack on Sojourn, or if he hadn't allowed himself to divine it» L6197. Ch29: «And I sensed nothing about him.» L6995 (Anakin, under his own roof).
25. **[S-32] Ch30 — the murder.** «And he moved in a blur.» L7217; lightning at maximum draw L7221 («drawing more deeply on the dark side than he ever had»); he weathers the Force storm (L7243 «to wash over Sidious and hurl objects to all corners»); choke: «Try to keep yourself alive while I choke the life out of you.» L7251 → **it beats a drunk, sleeping, non-defending P-32.** Sidious stands «absolutely still» when he realizes Plagueis is challenging him («Momentarily taken aback, Sidious stood absolutely still» L7219).
26. **[S-32] Ch30 — claimed midi-chlorian ability (STATEMENT).** «I could save you, of course. Return you from the brink, as you did Venamis. I could retask your body to repair the damage already done to your lungs, your hearts, your aged brain.» L7259 → **a claim, not shown**, and it contradicts Ch23's «couldn't be certain he had learned all of Plagueis's secrets» L5255. The two can be reconciled: he learned more in the final decade, or he's bluffing a dying man.
27. **[S-32] Ch30 — long-term mind clouding (STATEMENT).** «As we have clouded the minds of the Jedi, I clouded yours.» L7267 → he claims to have deceived P-32's senses for decades. It fits Ch18 (Plagueis «hidden» from Sidious) and the reverse. **Each hid things from the other.**

**S-32+ (boost; the moment of Plagueis's death)**
28. **[S-32+] Prologue — succession boost.** «the Force so strong within him that he feared he might disappear into it, never to return» L117; «it was less a transformation than an intensification-a gravitic shift» L117; «he felt the power of the dark side anoint him» L119; «The dark side had made him its property, and now he made the dark side his.» L159 → **a distinct amp version.** Every Sidious after TPM (ROTS, DE) is post-boost.
29. **[S-32+] Ch30 end — "something greater".** «a vague awareness of a power greater than himself» L7299 → ambiguous: the Force, Anakin, or the dead Plagueis.

### 3.3 Darth Tenebrous (T-67)
1. Lightning into the shaft, jointly (see P #1) L267 («tangles of blue electrical energy»).
2. **Speed > Plagueis.** «Nearly knocked over by the swiftness of Tenebrous's departure» L293.
3. **Force shield vs a lethane fireball.** «Tenebrous conjured a Force shield with his waving arms that met the fireball and contained it» L305 → a strong, quick shield.
4. **Precognition misread.** «Plagueis perceived the danger Tenebrous had foreseen earlier: his death.» L317; «the Bith had grown sluggish and expendable» L323 (Plagueis POV) → foresight without accuracy.
5. Statement on Plagueis: «Perhaps I was wrong to think you had no stomach for it.» L361; «You are fated to bring the Sith imperative to fruition» L347 (said while dying, possibly sincere).
6. **Scaling:** T-67 is fast and has good defensive Force. Killed by surprise. «lacked» innate sorcery talent, like Plagueis (Ch24, L2303 «and one that he had lacked, as well»).

### 3.4 Darth Venamis (V-67, V-41)
1. **[V-67] Ch6 — hangs in midair after his branch is cut.** «hung suspended in the air-no mean feat in itself-and continued the fight» L1547 → levitation, which Plagueis never shows.
2. **[V-67] Ch6 — counter-style specialist.** «Tenebrous had made Venamis an expert in Plagueis's style» L1547; «penetrated his defenses, searing the side of Plagueis's neck» L1549; he was building lightning when disarmed L1557 («Sensing a storm of Force lightning building in the Bith»).
3. **[V-67] Ch6 — taunt on perception.** «How powerful can you be if you failed to sense the death of your Master?» L1539
4. **[V-67] Ch7 — rating (STATEMENT, Plagueis POV).** «a being could have great potential in the Force and yet still be inept» L1593.
5. **[V-41] Ch24 — the resurrection subject.** «Plagueis had resurrected him» L5435.
6. **Scaling:** Venamis is a solid duelist (a tier-6 sort of profile), below P-67 (mid diff).

### 3.5 Darth Maul (M-54 infant → M-33/32)
1. **[M-54] Ch15 — strong in the Force as an infant.** «This one is strong in the Force.» L3709
2. **[M-54→] Ch21 — designed as a tool.** «Not an apprentice; not someone who could ever aspire to become a true Sith Lord.» L4933 (Sidious POV).
3. **[M-33] Ch23 — holo of a droid massacre.** «cleaved a Colicoid Eradicator droid down the middle and whirled to cut two others in half» L5195; «his speed was astounding» L5223; Plagueis grants him «mastery of the Jar'Kai technique» L5235 (but rates «Niman» and «dun m?ch» stylistically L5235 «Niman and ter?s k?si will never substitute for dun m?ch»).
4. **[M-33] Ch23 — the Hypori test (Sidious's account).** «he fought well, even after I deprived him of his lightsaber» L5205 → **M-33 < S-33**, clearly.
5. **[M-33] Ch23 — overrated.** «you allowed him to believe that he is more skilled than he actually is» L5215 (Plagueis).
6. **[M-32] Ch27 — Orsis.** «An up-and-coming contender at ten years of age and a champion at twelve.» L6185
7. **[M-32] Ch28 — Black Sun.** «I decapitated the Twi'lek.» L6393; «My blade halved the Nightsister after she tried to defeat me with summoned Force-lightning.» L6397 (beats a lightning-using Nightsister); «I drowned him.» L6405 (Garyn). **Limit:** «the Black Sun leader cut open your hand» L6441 → a lightly Force-sensitive gangster wounds him when he's distracted.
8. **[M-32] Ch28 — Crimson Corridor.** «killed two Jedi, along with beings of a dozen species, including a Hutt» L6563 (Shadow Hunter tie-in); **limit:** «he has the skill to scramble the minds of ordinary beings, but not to cloak himself from a Jedi» L6563; «Pavan somehow managed to outwit him» L6689.
9. **[M-32] Epilogue — Sidious's TPM framing.** «Maul had managed to kill a master sword fighter only to be overcome by a lesser one» L7317 → in Sidious's view, Qui-Gon (QG-32) > Obi-Wan (Padawan) as a swordsman, and Maul's loss to Obi-Wan was an upset.

### 3.6 Others
- **Dooku (D-54):** «Dooku was said to be one of the Order's finest lightsaber masters» L4185. **(D-33):** «he was known to be one of the Order's most skilled duelists» L5723; «capable of great cruelty» L5723; self-assessment «As skilled as I am with a lightsaber» L5737. **(D-32):** «Dooku was strong in the Force» L7421 (Sidious POV); «Already strong in the Force, trained in combat, and a diplomat, as well» L6031 (Plagueis POV). No feats.
- **Qui-Gon (QG-54/32):** Plagueis: «he is nothing like some of the others Dooku trained» L6833; «Qui-Gon will evade detection by the droids and wreak slow but inevitable havoc on the flagship» L6841; «a master sword fighter» (Sidious, Epilogue, same line as Maul #9). The duel with Maul on Tatooine is reported only («a brief confrontation» L6885).
- **Sifo-Dyas (54/32 BBY):** foresight of war: «I have also sensed that war is imminent.» L6637 He is manipulated into the clone order. «he would be one step ahead of me» L7367.
- **Anakin (32 BBY):** «the boy's concentration of midi-chlorians is unprecedented» L6979; «shown remarkable courage and Force ability» L7321; Sidious «sensed nothing about him» L6995.
- **Mighella (32 BBY):** a Nightsister lightning user, killed by Maul (see Maul #7).
- **Garyn (32 BBY):** «has some strength in the Force» L6175; wounds Maul.
- **Ni-Cada and Lo Bukk (~66 BBY):** kill Naat Lare (Ch8; reported).
- **Gean (lore, ~5 centuries earlier):** «managed to penetrate the Force fields Gravid had raised around their stronghold and intercede, killing her Master with her bare hands» L5815.

## 4. STATEMENTS that link versions (comparisons, ratings, self-assessments)

Rule: a statement counts only for the version it is about. **Comparative** lines that link two versions are listed here with both tags.

| # | Speaker / POV | About | Version(s) | Quote | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

**Reading of C5 vs C7–C8:** Sidious's private, mid-book view (C5) is uncertainty that leans toward *Plagueis ahead*. His public gloat over a dying man (C7–C8) claims parity and then supremacy. Since C5 is internal POV with no reason to lie, I weight it above the gloat. The C9 doctrine makes the book's thesis explicit: Sidious wins by being **more clever**, not by being **stronger**.

---

## 5. Character analyses

### 5.1 Darth Plagueis (Hego Damask)
- **Personality:** cold, patient and acquisitive («an investment that could, with proper effort, be maximized» L381). He is scientific, contemptuous of «vulgar morality» L1251, and proud. His obsession with immortality makes him both his own project and his own blind spot.
- **Arc:**
  - He murders Tenebrous and declares the old Rule of Two dead (P-67).
  - He builds an apprentice-*partner* (P-65 to P-54).
  - He is nearly killed by the Maladians (P-54b) and turns inward for twenty years (P-41 amp).
  - He re-emerges in his prime (P-33).
  - He fixates on Anakin and the Force's «strike back», and is murdered by the apprentice he thought he had made a partner (P-32).
- **Relationships:**
  - Tenebrous: resentment and an ideological split (science/fatalism vs will).
  - Venamis: rival, then laboratory subject.
  - Sidious: mentor, «torturer» L2941, and would-be co-chancellor.
  - Maul: dismissive («a fighting machine rather than a true apprentice» L5235).
  - Dooku: a backup candidate he never recruits.
  - Qui-Gon: respected as a threat.
  - Jabba: ally.
  - 11-4D: his only constant.
- **Abilities, by version:**
  - P-67: lightning, bolt absorption, master-rated dueling, blur speed, presence suppression, precognition, mind tricks; no midi-chlorian control.
  - P-54: midi-chlorian persuasion (healing, the Yinchorri bubble), Force-induced pregnancies, a Force wave that atomizes bodies, sonic roar, Force shield, choke, complete self-concealment.
  - P-41 amp: resurrection, self-rejuvenation, a higher count, the shared tipping of the Force.
  - P-33/32: midi-chlorian killing by command, better precognition, a «nuclear» aura.
- **Limits:**
  - Admittedly no innate sorcery talent.
  - Can't fly, leap the oculus (P-67), control weather, or teleport.
  - Lightning failed after his heart damage (P-54b).
  - Foresight is repeatedly overridden by pride and fear of exposure (Ch20).
  - Never sees his own murder coming.
  - Can't sustain his own life under suffocation.
  - He gets outmaneuvered by planners (the Gran/Maladians, Veruna's nuke, Sidious).
- **What the book adds to his scaling:**
  - A confirmed P-41 amp: his midi-chlorian count rose.
  - On-page resurrection, and killing by midi-chlorian command.
  - A dozen killers atomized while mortally wounded.
  - Superiority over S-54 (choke, concealment).
  - At TPM, Sidious privately unsure he had caught up.
  - **But no fair fight** with anyone of his tier, and a death by ambush in which he chose not to defend himself.

### 5.2 Darth Sidious (Palpatine)
- **Personality:** charming, cruel and calculating, with rage beneath a mask he has worn «since infancy» L3055. A born politician («A youth with no desire to enter politics, and yet born for it.» L2505). Envious («Repressing a sudden feeling of envy» L6197).
- **Arc:**
  - An untrained teen murders his family (S-65).
  - He becomes Plagueis's apprentice (S-64 to S-54) and slaughters the Gran household.
  - He co-tips the Force (S-41).
  - He runs the TPM plot (S-33).
  - He murders Plagueis (S-32).
  - He is anointed by the dark side (S-32+).
- **Relationships:**
  - Plagueis: teacher, never Master: «Teacher, yes, and for that I will be eternally grateful. But Master-never.» L7249
  - Maul: «an almost filial bond» L6875.
  - Dooku: a groomed ally.
  - Anakin: the planned apprentice.
  - Vidar Kim: the closest he came to «a true friendship», killed on Plagueis's orders.
  - Padmé: a pawn he underestimated («Everyone involved-including me-underestimated the abilities of our Queen.» L7353).
- **Abilities:**
  - Mental walls (S-65).
  - Untrained bulkhead-buckling telekinesis (S-65).
  - Blur speed, fire and ceiling telekinesis in combat (S-54).
  - Self-taught sorcery (poison nullification) (S-54).
  - Mind wipes and mind tricks.
  - Remote sensing of attacks (S-54).
  - Disarming Maul (S-33).
  - Max-draw lightning and a choke (S-32).
  - A claimed resurrection skill (S-32, statement).
  - The post-death boost (S-32+).
- **Limits:**
  - Poor foresight in TPM («none came»).
  - Missed Anakin entirely.
  - Deceived by Havac.
  - Choked by Plagueis without warning at S-54.
- **What the book adds:** it pins the S-32+ boost in its own words, and the «tenfold» growth to 33 BBY. S-33 > M-33 on the page. Sidious's POV is uncertain about Plagueis at S-33. His win over Plagueis is by **ambush and cleverness**.

### 5.3 Darth Tenebrous
- **Profile:** a Bith scientist-Sith who trusts «Bith science and computer projections» L6029 more than the Sith arts. Fast, with a strong shield. He foresaw his death but misread it. He secretly trained Venamis as insurance. **Scaling:** below P-67 strategically; possibly not in raw power.

### 5.4 Darth Venamis
- **Profile:** a young Bith, high midi-chlorian count, a counter-stylist. He levitates in a fight. He loses to P-67, then spends ~25 years as a comatose test subject who is killed and revived again and again. **Scaling:** a tier-6-ish duelist.

### 5.5 Darth Maul
- **Profile:** a «Half a clan pair, this one is» L3685 (his mother's words) Nightbrother, raised as a gladiator on Orsis, loyal and prideful («I have made him prideful» L5477). Lethal on fodder and minor Force users, but overrated per Plagueis, and outwitted by Pavan and Garyn. «There is no pain where strength lies.» L6411 **Scaling:** M-33 < S-33 (disarmed); M-32 > two Crimson Corridor Jedi; Qui-Gon framed as the better swordsman than Obi-Wan.

### 5.6 Dooku
- **Profile:** aristocratic, disillusioned, hungry for the dark side («hungry to bring the full power of the Force to bear» L5811). Explains the Chosen One prophecy. Leaves the Order after Qui-Gon's death. **Scaling:** rated as an elite duelist (D-54, D-33); no feats.

### 5.7 Qui-Gon Jinn
- **Profile:** a rogue Master and thorn in the Sith plan, «Qui-Gon was the key to everything.» L7107 He discovers Anakin. **Scaling:** «a master sword fighter» per Sidious; Plagueis fears him over Dooku's other students.

### 5.8 Sifo-Dyas
- **Profile:** anxious, prescient («I have also sensed that war is imminent» L6637), manipulated by Damask into the clone order. «he would be one step ahead of me» L7367 foreshadows *Labyrinth of Evil*.

### 5.9 Padmé, Obi-Wan, Anakin, Yoda, Mace (individual profiles)

Summary: Padmé is a 13-year-old prodigy installed by Palpatine who then outplays both Sith at Naboo. Obi-Wan is newly Knighted and «a lesser one» (L7317) in Sidious's eyes. Anakin has an unprecedented count and is Plagueis's nightmare. Yoda and Mace are background only, with no feat. Each profile below ends with a complete register of every sentence in the book that names the character (auto-harvested, verbatim, in book order).

#### 5.9.1 Padmé Naberrie / Queen Amidala (33–32 BBY)
- **Personality and arc:** a Naberrie of Naboo whose family Palpatine courts (L2623, L5983), she is installed as a teenage governor and then Queen by Palpatine's maneuvering, informs him of Veruna's death (L6477), and then escapes the blockade with the Jedi (L6855). She ends the book as the unexpected winner of the Naboo crisis.
- **Relationships:** Palpatine (patron who misjudges her); Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan (her escorts); Maul (sent to capture her: «Maul is to return Queen Amidala to Naboo and force her to sign a treaty», L6861).
- **Abilities and limits:** no Force ability. Her asset is political nerve.
- **Key line:** «The last thing the Sith needed was to have Amidala emerge as the hero of their manufactured drama.» (L7109).
- **Scaling implications:** none for combat. She is the clearest case in the book of both Sith being outplayed by a non-Force-user.

#### 5.9.2 Obi-Wan Kenobi (32 BBY)
- **Personality and arc:** Qui-Gon's Padawan at Naboo (L6831), newly Knighted in the Epilogue, where Palpatine sizes him up and Obi-Wan corrects Anakin: «"It's not for you to decide your destiny, Anakin," Obi-Wan said.» (L7473).
- **Relationships:** Qui-Gon (Master); Anakin (new Padawan); Palpatine (watches him).
- **Feats:** off-page only. He kills Maul at Theed; the Epilogue treats this as «Darth Maul's defeat at the hands of the Jedi» (L7317). Sidious dismisses him as «a lesser one» (L7317).
- **Scaling implications:** none new. Sidious's plan for him is political: «Let Obi-Wan instruct him in the ways of the Force» (L7477).

#### 5.9.3 Anakin Skywalker (32 BBY, age nine)
- **Arc:** found by Qui-Gon on Tatooine, «at the center of a vergence in the Force» (L6979); Plagueis must «sense him for himself» (L7017); taken to Coruscant, and finally made Obi-Wan's Padawan (Epilogue).
- **What the Sith think:** Qui-Gon sees him «as the Jedi's prophesied Chosen One!» (L7015). Plagueis reads him as a possible product of the galactonic shift: «And what will become of the boy then?» (L7003, Sidious).
- **Key quotes:** «"It's like a dream come true, sir," Anakin said in genuine sincerity.» (L7467); Sidious's plan, «let Skywalker grow embittered over the next decade as his mother aged in slavery» (L7477).
- **Scaling implications:** potential only. His midi-chlorian count is the book's power signal; there are no feats.

  - Epilogue L7475 «Guide you to me, young Skywalker.»
  - Epilogue L7477 «Let Obi-Wan instruct him in the ways of the Force, and let Skywalker grow embittered over the next decade as his mother aged in slavery, the galaxy deteriorated around him, and his fellow Jedi fell to inextricable conflicts.»

#### 5.9.4 Yoda (33–32 BBY)
- **Role:** background on the Council. Sifo-Dyas confides in him without effect («I've confessed as much to Master Yoda and others, but to no avail.», L6637). He takes Dooku from Serenno but «had failed to take Serenno from Dooku» (L6031). Valorum on Yoda: «Inscrutable as ever,» «But troubled, I think.» (L5173). Sifo-Dyas says Yoda and the others seem «unconcerned. Or preoccupied. I'm no longer sure.» (L6637). Plagueis predicts the Council will «double their meditation sessions in an effort to peer into the future, only to discover it clouded» (L5301).
- **Scaling implications:** none on-page. The clouding line is a STATEMENT that the Sith shift has already blinded the Council's precognition.
- **Complete quote register (10 lines: every sentence that names Yoda, verbatim, in book order):**
  - Ch22 Ordinary Beings L5171 «Instead of responding to that comment, Palpatine said, "And Master Yoda?"»
  - Ch23 Under the Midnight Sun L5301 «Yoda and the rest of the Council members will double their meditation sessions in an effort to peer into the future, only to discover it clouded and unknowable.»
  - Ch25 The Discreet Charm of the Meritocracy L5733 «Compounding their initial error in dispatching Jedi, Master Yoda and the rest have refused to send reinforcements to search for survivors."»
  - Ch26 Their Baser Nature L6031 «Yoda had taken Dooku from Serenno, but he had failed to take Serenno from Dooku.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6581 «Though ineligible for reelection, recently stripped of some of his Senatorial powers, and frequently engaged in defending himself against accusations by the Ethics Committee, Valorum had managed to make himself the center of attention, due to the presence of Masters Yoda, Mace Windu, and Adi Gallia among his followers.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6615 «Master C'baoth here, Masters Yoda and Gallia there, and yet no sign of Master Dooku."»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6637 «I've confessed as much to Master Yoda and others, but to no avail.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6693 «"I'm supposed to deliver it to the Jedi," Palpatine said with obvious amusement; and looking around, added, "Perhaps to Yoda or Windu..."»
  - Ch29 The Force Strikes Back L6947 «But for Yoda, Mace Windu, and the rest, Valorum is a known quantity, whereas Senators Antilles and Teem and you have yet to disclose your true agendas.»
  - Epilogue L7317 «Still, it gave him great pleasure to stand among Yoda, Mace Windu, and other Masters and watch Qui-Gon Jinn's body reduced to ash, knowing that the Jedi was just the first casualty in a war that had been declared but not yet begun; one in which ten thousand Jedi would follow Qui-Gon to the grave...»

### 5.10 Other named characters with real roles (individual profiles)

Every named side character with a real role in the book gets a profile here, followed by the complete register of sentences that name them. Named characters with no real role (one to three passing mentions, so no profile): Sly Moore, Armand Isard, San Hill (Larsh Hill's son; named only in passing), Darus, Tenebrous's Bith associates, and the Gran Senators other than Pax Teem.

#### 5.10.1 11-4D ("FourDee"), Plagueis's droid (67–32 BBY)
- **Personality:** precise, unflappable, literal. A medical and research droid who becomes Plagueis's lab partner and the POV for the Woebegone massacre (Ch4).
- **Arc:** Woebegone crew droid (Ch3) → witnesses the massacre and becomes Plagueis's servant (Ch4) → runs the Venamis experiments on Aborah (L2941) → is overwhelmed by the shift (L5435) → present to the end.
- **Feats:** tracks Venamis's candidates (L1671); its sensors analyze a Shi'ido skinshifter (Ch8); it does «meticulous damage» to Venamis's organs for Plagueis's experiments (L2941).
- **Limits:** «The enormity of the event had stunned Sidious into silence and overwhelmed and addled 11-4D's processors» (L5435).
- **Key lines:** «OneOne-FourDee's olfactory sensors detected an outpouring of pheromones that signaled the death of the Kaleesh.» (L841); «The Muun's reaction to the barrage of bolts that converged on him required almost more processing power than the droid had at its disposal.» (L831).
- **Scaling implications:** 11-4D's POV is the most neutral narrator of Plagueis's P-67 combat speed (Woebegone, Ch4).
- **Complete quote register (113 lines: every sentence that names 11-4D, verbatim, in book order):**
  - Ch3 Woebegone L479 «The only nonsentient was a bipedal, multi-appendaged droid called "OneOne-FourDee", after its model number.»
  - Ch3 Woebegone L521 «"Oh, that you were," Zuto said, reigniting a chorus of laughter that accompanied them into the Woebegone's main cabin space, where 11-4D was waiting.»
  - Ch3 Woebegone L537 «Blir' and Semasalli to the cockpit; Zuto, Wandau, and PePe to check that the cargo had been properly stowed; Maa Kaap and 11-4D to seal the ship; and Captain Lah to get clearance from Bal'demnic spaceport control.»
  - Ch3 Woebegone L687 «In the main cabin space, 11-4D had been monitoring the conversation of the crew members since their return from cargo bay 4.»
  - Ch3 Woebegone L695 «Before Maa Kaap or anyone else could respond, the captain entered the cabin space, clearly confounded though doing her best to disguise it. 11-4D noted increased blood flow in her head-tails, which were themselves sensory organs, and a change in her pigmentation-a Togruta response to nervous tension that sometimes prompted involuntary mimetic camouflage.»
  - Ch3 Woebegone L743 «Raising his big hand, he beckoned to 11-4D.»
  - Ch3 Woebegone L749 «"Let FourDee finish," Maa Kaap said.»
  - Ch3 Woebegone L783 «I'm the captain, 11-4D could almost hear her remind herself.»
  - Ch4 The Meaning of Death L819 «The Woebegone had just reverted to realspace when 11-4D's audio sensors registered unusual sounds from aft: an activation click, a prolonged hiss of energy, a dopplering slash, a stuttering exhalation of breath.»
  - Ch4 The Meaning of Death L821 «As for justice, 11-4D couldn't retrieve a single instance of the four crew members having performed an offense that warranted capital punishment.»
  - Ch4 The Meaning of Death L823 «That the Muun permitted them to do so furnished 11-4D with yet another mystery-at least until it realized that the Muun was merely courting combat.»

  - Ch4 The Meaning of Death L829 «From the passageway that led to the cockpit came the rapid footfalls of the pilot, Blir', and the ship's Dresselian navigator, Semasalli. 11-4D knew that they had been monitoring cam feeds of the cargo bay, and thought it likely that they had witnessed whatever sentence the Muun had levied on Captain Lah.»
  - Ch4 The Meaning of Death L831 «Only 11-4D's ability to calculate trajectories and react instantaneously to danger kept it from being on the receiving end of any of the numerous ricochets.»
  - Ch4 The Meaning of Death L839 «OneOne-FourDee's audio pickups registered the snap of the Zabrak's spine and the bursting of pulmonary arteries.»

#### 5.10.2 Sate Pestage (54–32 BBY)
- **Personality:** cynical and worldly: «"Some of us are simply born into it," Pestage said, indifferent to Palpatine's penetrating gaze.» (L3955).
- **Arc:** Plagueis finds him for Palpatine (L3919) → becomes Palpatine's fixer on Coruscant (Ch16–17) → handles the Vidar Kim fallout and the Maladian warning (L4721) → still at Palpatine's side in the Epilogue (L7425).
- **Relationships:** Palpatine (aide), Doriana and Greejatus (cabal colleagues).
- **Scaling implications:** none. Part of Sidious's political-network feat.
- **Complete quote register (55 lines: every sentence that names Sate Pestage, verbatim, in book order):**

  - Ch23 Under the Midnight Sun L5259 «But when Sidious enlisted the aid of the Devaronian smuggler to instigate the Yinchorri, he had not only made contact by holoprojector-without revealing his Sith identity, of course-but also put him in touch with Pestage and Doriana, who had assisted in the dumping of the bodies of the dead Jedi on Valorum's threshold and had facilitated the insertion of the Yinchorri warriors tasked with infiltrating the Jedi Temple.»
  - Ch24 Sith'ari L5337 «Palpatine had arrived with Pestage, and had met downside with Janus Greejatus before rendezvousing with Veruna and some of the members of his advisory council at Theed Hangar, including Prime Counselor Kun Lago and the King's sharp-featured female security chief Maris Magneta.»
  - Ch24 Sith'ari L5343 «Pestage failed to restrain a short laugh.»
  - Ch24 Sith'ari L5347 «Palpatine flashed Pestage a look that said nothing and turned back to Veruna.»

  - Ch25 The Discreet Charm of the Meritocracy L5809 «In the space of a standard year he had gone from leading two lives to managing almost half a dozen: apprentice to Plagueis; Master to Maul; distinguished Senator; ally of Supreme Chancellor Valorum; and leader of a growing cabal of conspirators that included Pestage, Doriana, Greejatus-in line to replace him in the Senate-the Force-sensitive human Sim Aloo, intelligence analyst Armand Isard, Eriadu Senator Wilhuff Tarkin, and Umbaran telepath Sly Moore, whom he had made his covert aide.»
  - Ch27 Calibrations L6147 «Have Pestage transport the ship to the LiMerge Building, so that you can present it as a gift to your apprentice.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6569 «"I instructed Pestage to clear a route through a seldom-used docking bay.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6571 «"Why not simply have him surrender the crystal to Pestage?" he asked at last.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6697 «"Pestage and Doriana are escorting him downside, where he'll receive medical attention, maybe even a new hand, and a comfortable hotel suite in which to spend the final day of his life."»
  - Ch29 The Force Strikes Back L6797 «Pestage, Doriana, Janus Greejatus, Armand Isard, and others were also busy behind the scenes, planting incriminating evidence where necessary, and seeing to it that instances of graft were made public.»
  - Ch29 The Force Strikes Back L6887 «"Pestage and Doriana have put a plan in place that will weaken the campaigns of your chief rivals," Plagueis was saying as he and Palpatine hurried toward the skyhopper that would carry them to the antigrav platform on which the Royal Starship had been cleared to land.»
  - Ch30 Taking the Future from the Now L7059 «But Panaka was there, in his brown leather cap and jerkin, along with Sate Pestage and Kinman Doriana.»
  - Ch30 Taking the Future from the Now L7117 «As daylight was fading over The Works, Sate Pestage informed them that Senators Teem and Antilles were crippled, and that some of Coruscant's political oddsmakers were now giving Palpatine the edge in the election.»

#### 5.10.3 Kinman Doriana (54–32 BBY)

- **Role:** Palpatine's aide; not Force-sensitive («That Doriana wasn't strong in the Force made no difference.», L3397); watches the Maladians for Pestage (L4721).
- **Scaling implications:** none.

#### 5.10.4 Ars Veruna, King of Naboo (54–32 BBY)
- **Personality:** ambitious and corrupt («Tapalo, Veruna, and the rest of that group of thugs are interested only in power and wealth», L2647, Cosinga).
- **Arc:** Tapalo's ally (Ch9) → made King with Sith help (Ch15–24) → turns on them, tipping Black Sun and the Gran to bomb Sojourn (Ch26) → abdicates and is killed by Plagueis's midi-chlorian command (Ch27).
- **Key lines:** «"Sith," Veruna said, as if weakened by the very word.» (L6345); Plagueis to him: «Your abdication would have been enough, had you not tried first to have me killed.» (L6323); Veruna: «"You were born the son of a wealthy Muun, and transformed that wealth into power."» (L6333).
- **Scaling implications:** his death is Plagueis's signature P-33/32 feat (killing by telling midi-chlorians to leave). Sidious even wonders if he «had actually failed to divine Veruna's attack on Sojourn» (L6197), a rare admission of a precognitive miss.
- **Complete quote register (130 lines: every sentence that names Ars Veruna, verbatim, in book order):**
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2123 «His name was Ars Veruna, and although he didn't hold a position in Naboo's monarchical government, he was speaking for the current pretender to the throne, Bon Tapalo, and was likely to be appointed governor of the city of Theed in the event of Tapalo's election.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2125 «"Our campaign has been stalled by recent allegations from the leaders of some of the royal houses," Veruna was telling the gathered Muuns.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2127 «"Are all the Naboo as hirsute and elaborately costumed as this Veruna?"»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2135 «Seated with his back to the scenic view beyond the window wall, Plagueis studied the holoimage of Veruna.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2135 «But politicians were a necessary evil, and, if nothing else, Veruna burned with greed and ambition, which meant that he could be manipulated if necessary.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2145 «"First, they leaked word of the mining survey we had performed," Veruna said, "but the revelation failed to have the intended effect, because several members of the electorate favor opening Naboo to galactic trade.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2149 «"We haven't been able to determine the source," Veruna said.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2157 «Veruna stroked his tapered beard.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2165 «Veruna nodded.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2169 «"Veruna is correct.»

  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2193 «Tapalo and Veruna had insisted on sending one of Naboo's signature starships to transport the Muuns from Muunilinst, and the sleek Nubian had set down at Theed spaceport, a small facility that would have to be enlarged twentyfold if Naboo hoped to one day become a player in galactic commerce.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2195 «A cort?ge of air skimmers carried the black-robed Muuns through streets better suited to pedestrian traffic to the interior courtyard of an ancient palace, where pretender to the throne Bon Tapalo, Veruna, and several other human advisers and would-be ministers of both sexes were on hand to welcome them.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2195 «Veruna, on the other hand, immediately fell into step alongside Damask as the Muuns were being escorted into the central building of the complex.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2201 «Veruna gestured to himself in question.»

#### 5.10.5 Bon Tapalo, King of Naboo (65–54 BBY)
- **Role:** the monarch Plagueis and the Banking Clan back in Ch9–14. Cosinga despises him: «my grandfather ... eventually succumbed to the injuries Tapalo's blade inflicted» (L2643; family-feud backstory).
- **Scaling implications:** none.
- **Complete quote register (57 lines: every sentence that names Bon Tapalo, verbatim, in book order):**

  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2141 «Not every Naboo, however, was in favor of involving the planet in trade of the sort that would result from making plasma energy available, and a cadre of nobles had thrown their support behind Tapalo's chief rival for the monarchy.»

  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2161 «Roughly sixty standard years ago, at the height of a war between the Naboo and the Gungans, our monarch was killed, and it has now emerged that some members of the very same royal houses that oppose Tapalo struck a secret deal with a mercenary group to intervene in the war should the Naboo suffer further setbacks.»
  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2169 «In the hope of avoiding a scandal that could divide the electorate, the head of the royal house has perpetuated a lie that the Tapalo group chanced on the information and made it public, when actually only someone with access to the family archives could have discovered it."»

  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2195 «A cort?ge of air skimmers carried the black-robed Muuns through streets better suited to pedestrian traffic to the interior courtyard of an ancient palace, where pretender to the throne Bon Tapalo, Veruna, and several other human advisers and would-be ministers of both sexes were on hand to welcome them.»

  - Ch9 Untapped Reserves L2209 «Naboo blossom wine was still being poured when the Muuns made their pitch to the Tapalo group, employing the courtyard's holoprojector to provide a virtual portrait of what Theed and other nearby cities might look like ten years on.»

#### 5.10.6 Cosinga Palpatine (65 BBY)
- **Personality:** proud, controlling, contemptuous of his son: «"Hated you more than you know," Cosinga said, allowing his ire to rise once more.» (L2909); «Cosinga flung his words with cruel abandon.» (L2885).
- **Arc:** opposes his son's friendship with Damask (L2857) → is killed by Palpatine in the airspeeder (Ch11), the moment his son's power «finally burst forth» (L3055).
- **Key line about his son:** «I've known it since the first moment I tried to swaddle you, and you fought me with a strength that was too powerful for your size or age.» (L2905).
- **Scaling implications:** the murder is S-65's first raw feat (untrained Force-killing of guards and family).

#### 5.10.7 Vidar Kim (65–54 BBY)

- **Arc:** a Naboo Senator who learns too much about the Trade Federation deals (Ch16) → «With great subtlety Sidious had manipulated Vidar Kim into a position where he had become a liability, and therefore had to die.» (L4001) → killed by a Maladian (L4047).
- **Relationships:** Palpatine (protégé who betrays him); Ronhar (the son he gave to the Jedi).
- **Scaling implications:** none. Feat of Sidious's manipulation.

#### 5.10.8 Ronhar Kim (54 BBY)
- **Personality:** devoted to the Order: «that he considers the Temple to be his home and the Jedi to be his family» (L4079).
- **Arc:** Vidar's son, given to the Jedi (L3421) → chases the Maladian assassin across Coruscant traffic (L4041, L4047) → meets Palpatine at the funeral, where Palpatine tests his ability to hide from a Jedi (L4115) → appears again at Serenno with Dooku (Ch17–18).
- **Feats:** leaps from a moving taxi onto the assassin's monospeeder (L4041: «leaping from a Coruscant taxi in midflight onto a monospeeder»).
- **Limits:** the assassin kills herself with neurotoxin before he can question her (L4051). He cannot sense Palpatine: «"No," the Jedi said, perhaps more firmly than he intended.» (L4151).
- **Scaling implications:** S-54's Force concealment fools a Jedi Knight at close range.

  - Ch10 The Cycle of Violence L2541 «Seated alongside Plagueis, Larsh Hill leaned forward to address Pax Teem.»

#### 5.10.11 Kerred Santhe (the elder and the younger)
- **Role:** the elder Kerred was «Plagueis's first murder under the tutelage of» Tenebrous (L1811). The younger runs Santhe/Sienar and later Santhe Security: «Santhe Security squads made several attempts on my Master's life afterward, but we dealt with them.» (L3807, Plagueis). His guards die when Sidious strikes (L4793).
- **Scaling implications:** Plagueis's account of the elder's death: «the dark side of the Force had Santhe in its grip and no drug or resuscitation technique was equal to the task» (L3805).
- **Complete quote register (38 lines: every sentence that names Kerred Santhe, verbatim, in book order):**

- **Key lines:** «"Appearances can be deceiving," Jabba said.» (L5671); «Jabba wriggled, restraining his anger.» (L5691).
- **Scaling implications:** none. Plagueis will not ask Jabba for a favor «out of concern for what the dark side might demand of him in return» (L6855).

#### 5.10.15 Finis Valorum (33–32 BBY)
- **Role:** Supreme Chancellor brought down by the aurodium frame-up («emptied their weapons on the members of the directorate», L6133) and the Naboo vote. He trusts Palpatine to the end: «"I know that you will try, Supreme Chancellor."» (L6783, Valorum misreading the title; spoken to Palpatine).
- **Scaling implications:** none.

#### 5.10.16 Lorn Pavan (32 BBY)
- **Role:** an information broker who obtains Hath Monchar's holocron, survives Maul long enough to deliver it, and is then killed: «The fact that Pavan's right hand had been cleanly and recently amputated told me at once that the two fought in one of the air locks.» (L6685); «"I suspect that Pavan somehow managed to outwit him and take him by surprise."» (L6689); «Lorn Pavan was dead by Maul's lightsaber» (L6717).
- **Scaling implications:** a non-Force-user outwits M-32 once. That is a limit on Maul's judgment, not his power.
- **Complete quote register (8 lines: every sentence that names Lorn Pavan, verbatim, in book order):**
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6685 «"It was dropped into my hand by none other than the information broker Maul had been pursuing and thought dead-Lorn Pavan.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6685 «The fact that Pavan's right hand had been cleanly and recently amputated told me at once that the two fought in one of the air locks."»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6687 «"This Pavan defeated Maul?"»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6689 «"But I suspect that Pavan somehow managed to outwit him and take him by surprise."»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6691 «"Then Pavan must know what the holocron contains."»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6695 «"Pavan," Damask snapped.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6699 «"In any event, it wasn't Pavan who handed you the holocron.»
  - Ch28 Chain of Command L6717 «Lorn Pavan was dead by Maul's lightsaber, a day before an artificial hand was to have been grafted to the information broker's stub of forearm.»

#### 5.10.17 Alexi Garyn (32 BBY)
- **Role:** Black Sun's leader («the Vigos are grooming Alexi Garyn to assume control», L1311), who «has some strength in the Force» (L6175). He wounds Maul's hand, learns Maul's identity, and is drowned: «I drowned him.» (L6405, Maul).
- **Scaling implications:** a mildly Force-sensitive gangster lands a hit on M-32, which is Sidious's point when he scolds Maul («You must deliver a killing strike and be done with it.», L6445).
- **Complete quote register (14 lines: every sentence that names Alexi Garyn, verbatim, in book order):**

  - Ch26 Their Baser Nature L6003 «Ask Alexi Garyn.»
  - Ch27 Calibrations L6143 «Is the Zabrak-Maul, as you call him-capable of dealing with Alexi Garyn and his Vigos?"»
